data.body:
[P2] Record the deadline failure before throwing it

This cutoff throws without recording `lifecycleFailure` or signaling execution termination. A handler's broad exception catch can therefore swallow it and return a fallback. With an inline executor, the handler can cross the cutoff, catch the rejected durable operation, and complete before `awaitInvocationOutcome()` starts; that wait accepts the completed future and finalization reports `SUCCEEDED`. Record the lifecycle failure before throwing so terminal preparation cannot accept a result after a swallowed deadline interruption. Add a regression covering this caught-admission path.
